svg.title: Steam traps: ball-float, inverted-bucket, balanced-pressure thermostatic, bimetallic and thermodynamic disc, each shown open and closed
svg.text: Steam traps: what each one senses, shown open (left) and closed (right)
1. Ball-float trap (mechanical, senses density): the float rides on the condensate level
2. Inverted-bucket trap (mechanical): steam in the bucket makes it float and shut the valve
3. Balanced-pressure thermostatic trap: the capsule expands at steam temperature
4. Bimetallic thermostatic trap: two bonded metals bend when hot
5. Thermodynamic disc trap: flash steam over the disc snaps it onto the seats
